PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Overload every socket

2. When learning Safety on Raised Platforms, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Safety on Raised Platforms.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Safety on Raised Platforms.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Safety on Raised Platforms.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Safety on Raised Platforms.

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

4. When learning Oblique Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Oblique Projection.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Oblique Projection.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Oblique Projection.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Oblique Projection.

5. When learning Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.

6. When learning Handling Waste Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Handling Waste Materials.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Handling Waste Materials.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Handling Waste Materials.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Handling Waste Materials.

7. When learning Holding Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Holding Tools.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Holding Tools.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Holding Tools.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Holding Tools.

8. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

9. When learning Driving Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Driving Tools.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Driving Tools.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Driving Tools.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Driving Tools.

10. When learning Handling Hazardous Substances, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Handling Hazardous Substances.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Handling Hazardous Substances.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Handling Hazardous Substances.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Handling Hazardous Substances.

11. When learning Wood, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Wood.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wood.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wood.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wood.

12. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Handling Hazardous Substances and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Self- Exploration and Career Development and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Oblique Projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
